_readme: The in-game Field Guide (J, or Pause > Field Guide). Edit the text here; numbers (HP, damage, prices...) are filled in from the game data automatically. Add an entry under a section using the thing's id. 'lore' is a short paragraph, 'tips' is a list of one-liners.

revolver.lore: A trusty six-shooter. Accurate, quick to reload, and every rancher's first friend.
tips: Aim (right mouse) for a tighter, zoomed shot.
Glowing weak spots take double damage.

lever_rifle.lore: A long gun that punches clean through beetle shell. Slow to cycle, but nothing laughs it off.
tips: Pierces armour: your answer to Rattler Beetles.
Zooms 2.2x when aimed.

coach_shotgun.lore: Two barrels of buckshot for when the bugs are already on the porch.
tips: Aiming tightens the spread.
Useless at range, brutal up close.

blunderbuss.lore: A bell-mouthed flintlock that throws a fistful of nails and shot.
tips: One shot, then a slow muzzle-load: make it count.
Brutal against anything that reaches your plateau.

crank_gatling.lore: A six-barrel gatling you crank by hand, with a drum on top.
tips: Hold fire: it winds up for a moment, then keeps firing.
Sixty rounds a drum; swapping drums takes a few seconds.

dust_mite.lore: Rust-red scuttlers that come in clouds. One shot each, but there are always more.
tips: Gatling Posts and Chili Mortars eat swarms.
Never let a pack reach the lip unchallenged.

wolf_spider.lore: Fast, long-legged hunters that leap up the rock in bounds.
tips: Lasso Harpoons pin them mid-climb.
Watch for sudden leaps near the top.

rattler_beetle.lore: Teal tanks with a front shell that shrugs off small arms.
tips: Hit them from above or behind, where the shell is thin.
Buffalo Rifles and the lever-action pierce the shell.

spitter_scorpion.lore: Clings halfway up and spits acid at your turrets.
tips: Turrets on scaffolding can see further down.
They give up and climb after a while.

brood_mother.lore: A bloated spider carrying a living cargo of spiderlings.
tips: Hit her hard and fast: the brood bursts out at half health.
Splash turrets clean up the spiderlings.

spiderling.lore: A brood mother's children. Tiny, quick and many.
tips: Mortars and repeaters handle them fine.

burrow_tick.lore: Digs under the plateau and surfaces among your crops.
tips: Keep a gun handy near the farm.
House turrets cover the yard.

dragonfly_bandit.lore: Flies straight over the canyon and snatches what it can.
tips: Shoot them down yourself or with plateau guards.
They ignore cliff-face turrets.

crop_weevil.lore: Heads for your farm plots and chews them bare.
tips: Weevils pay walls no mind: they head straight for the crops.
Bear traps on the approach help.

iron_tumble.lore: The boss: a giant silver rhinoceros beetle with a horn like a church steeple and a tumbleweed stuck on its back. It comes on the last wave and rams the house when it reaches the top.
tips: Your partner's turrets hit its back as it climbs.
Shoot its glowing belly from above.

queen_spider.lore: A black widow the size of a buckboard, crowned in bone. She climbs slow and spits silk at anything that shoots at her.
tips: Watch her spinnerets: when they glow white she's about to spit a web.
A webbed turret holds fire: shoot the white cocoon (three revolver shots) or wait 8 seconds.
She never webs more than three turrets at once.

burrow_beetle.lore: A shovel-headed digger that would rather go through your plateau than up your cliff.
tips: A trail of dust puffs shows where it is underground.
Cracks and an orange ring mark where it will burst up, three seconds early: the top level of every scaffold inside comes down.
Lantern light forces it up early, before it reaches your scaffolds.
It can only be hurt above ground, so be there when it surfaces.

tumble_titan.lore: A giant scarab that rolls a boulder bigger than a wagon up the wall, just to drop it on your house.
tips: The boulder shields it from shots from your lip, so shoot the boulder.
Mortars and dynamite near the boulder chip it too.
Cracked through, the boulder rolls back over the Titan: a third of its health in one go.
Reaching the top with it, the boulder flattens everything in a line across your plateau.

locust_lord.lore: A crowned locust that rules the swarm from the air, high over the canyon.
tips: His swarm sac glows before every cloud of six locusts.
Cliff turrets can't touch him: build anti-air, or shoot him yourself.
The locusts go for crops and water; down him and they stop coming.

acid_matriarch.lore: A scorpion queen carrying her brood, with an acid sac the size of a water barrel.
tips: She clings about halfway up and spits for half a minute before climbing on.
Her tail bulb swells green before every spit.
Acid eats a turret for 14 seconds unless a Water Cannon near it fires: each shot washes every turret around it.
A Water Cannon hit on her rinses out the spit she's winding up.

locust.lore: One of the Swarm Lord's locusts. One bite of corn and it's gone.
tips: Anti-air flak and shotguns clear the clouds.

hive_drone.lore: A stubby wasp shaken out of the Hive Wagon's hive.
tips: Splash and fire clear them as they climb.

mirage_mantis.lore: A praying mantis the colour of hot sand that only hunts inside a dust storm. She is always a shimmer of heat haze, and every few seconds she slips almost out of sight altogether.
tips: While she has faded, turrets lose her: keep shooting her yourself, you can still hit the ripple.
Build a lantern post near her climb: in its light she stays solid and every turret keeps firing.

hive_wagon.lore: A plated bug the size of a stagecoach, rolling on wheel-discs, with a paper wasp hive roped onto its back. Every hit stirs the hive up.
tips: While it's under fire it shakes out a burst of drones every couple of seconds, and a last swarm when it dies: kill it fast, with everything at once.
Splash turrets and fire patches clear the drones.

stilt_strider.lore: A harvestman slung between eight impossibly long legs. It holds its body far out from the wall and steps straight over the lip.
tips: Shoot its legs: every third broken leg drops it to the canyon floor.
A crippled Strider climbs slower and takes more damage. Turrets aim at its knees half the time.

thunder_cicada.lore: A hammer-headed cicada with amber drums on its sides. When it drums, the whole canyon hears it, and turrets in the ring are shaken senseless.
tips: Watch for the glowing ring on your plateau: everything inside is stunned for 4 seconds when the screech lands.
Spread your turrets out. It sits still while it drums: that's your moment to pour fire into it.

bone_collector.lore: A black-and-orange burying beetle with a cattle skull on its back. It eats the dead, and the more it eats the bigger it gets.
tips: It stops to feed on the corpse pile at the cliff foot: shoot the pile apart, or burn it with blasts and fire, before it gets there.
Bugs killed right beside it are a meal too: kill it before the swarm around it.

gatling_post.lore: A hand-cranked gatling on a post. Shreds swarms, scratches armour.
tips: Build it for your partner's cliff: it can't shoot your own.

buffalo_rifle.lore: A heavy rifle nest that puts a hole through anything.
tips: Pierces armour.

water_cannon.lore: Knocks climbers clean off the rock. Needs no ammo.
tips: The higher a bug is, the harder it falls.

chili_mortar.lore: Lobs flaming chili onto the cliff face. Burns chili as ammo.
tips: Great against packs climbing together.

dynamite_lobber.lore: Arcs dynamite for a big splash. Each stick costs 1 scrap.
tips: Best on crowded lanes.

lasso_harpoon.lore: Pins one climber in place for a few seconds.
tips: Pair it with a Buffalo Rifle.

scattergun_post.lore: Last line: a brutal blast at bugs that reach your plateau.
tips: Never shoots cliff faces.

sharpshooter_tower.lore: Last line: a lookout with a long rifle over your yard.
tips: Never shoots cliff faces.

porch_repeater.lore: House turret: a quick twin gun on the porch, balcony or roof deck.
tips: Only shoots bugs near your house.

rooftop_cannon.lore: House turret: grapeshot that bursts over bugs at your door.
tips: Only shoots bugs near your house.

duck_gun.lore: A punt gun meant for a whole flock of ducks. Now it's for dragonflies.
tips: Air defence goes in the second row from the lip.
Slow but hits hard: good against a lone bandit.

sky_sweeper.lore: Two crank gatlings bolted together and pointed at the sky.
tips: Shoots any flier over either plateau or the canyon.
Weak per bullet; great against a swarm of bandits.

powder_flak.lore: Powder shells timed to burst in mid-air.
tips: Hits every flier in the burst.
Best where bandits bunch up over your farm.

net_thrower.lore: A spring arm that flings weighted nets.
tips: A netted flier hangs in the air for a few seconds.
Pair it with a Duck Gun or Sky Sweeper to finish them.

firework_battery.lore: A rack of skyrockets with very short fuses.
tips: Long range, big bursts, punches through armour.
Each rocket costs 1 scrap.
Expensive: save it for blood moons.

big_bertha.lore: A ten-barrel crank Gatling bolted to a buckboard wagon. She wants a gunner: hold the trigger and she spins up and hoses the far wall until the barrels glow.
tips: Takes 2 x 2 of bare ground. Tap E to sit in her; the mouse aims, hold LMB to fire.
Let go before the barrels glow red: overheated, she's quiet until they cool.
Left alone she still fires, at half rate and half damage.

whaler.lore: A whaling ballista on a timber sledge. The barbed harpoon goes in on a chain and holds a big bug fast to the wall.
tips: LMB throws the harpoon; a chained bug stops climbing for a few seconds.
Hold RMB to reel it down the wall: the further you drag it, the harder it falls when the chain lets go.
Your answer to bosses and armoured beetles. Unmanned, it only harpoons big bugs.

thunder_mule.lore: Three stubby mortars on a mule cart. The mule doesn't care for the noise.
tips: Sitting in it shows the shells' arc and a landing ring on the far wall.
One pull lobs a three-shell salvo: aim at the crowd near the top.
Long reload, and the shells take a moment to land: lead the climb.

sky_hound.lore: Twin flak barrels on a sandbagged turntable. Every shell bursts in a black cloud.
tips: Shells burst beside the first flier near your aim, or where you aim.
The cloud keeps stinging anything that flies through it.
Turns almost all the way round: it covers your own sky too.

twin_gatling.lore: Two Gatlings yoked to one crank and a shared drum. Twice the lead of a Gatling Post.
tips: Still half damage on armour: pair it with a big-game gun.

hornets_nest.lore: A dozen barrels on a spinning drum. The shot rattles from one bug into the next.
tips: Each hit ricochets into up to two more bugs within 3 m: best on packed swarms.
Half damage on armour.

elephant_battery.lore: A double rifle built for elephants, bolted to a sledge. Each round goes clean through.
tips: Each round carries on into two more bugs in its line.
Pierces armour, +50% on heavy bugs.

rail_spike_driver.lore: A steam ram that drives a railroad spike between two rails. Slow, and nothing stops it.
tips: Skewers every climber in a line down the wall; the last one is pinned to the rock.
Aimed at the top bug, it takes the whole lane under it.

gatling_porch.lore: A Gatling bolted to the house. It covers the whole yard from the porch.
tips: Only fires at bugs on your plateau, never at cliffs.
Reaches the whole yard, not just the doorstep.

steam_cannon.lore: A coal-fired boiler bolted to a brass nozzle. Every blast is a cone of scalding steam: the highest climbers in it let go and fall, and everything left in the fog crawls.
tips: Knocks off up to three small climbers a blast, the highest first.
Heavy bugs only slip a little; bosses barely at all.
Pair it with a Gatling Post: slowed bugs are easy pickings.

flood_gate.lore: A dammed timber tank on the lip. It takes twenty seconds to fill, then throws the sluice and sends a flood down a whole lane of the far wall.
tips: Washes every small bug in a lane-wide band off the wall at once.
Heavy bugs slip a few metres; bosses hardly budge.
Best on a lane the bugs crowd into.

twin_mortar.lore: Two tubes on one carriage. Each salvo drops a blast shell on the pack and a chili fire shell just above it, so whatever lives through the bang climbs into the flames.
tips: Eats a chili and a scrap every salvo.
Slow shells: fast bugs are gone before they land.
Can't touch fliers.

bola_launcher.lore: A spring gun with a revolving drum of bolas. Each throw wraps two climbers in weighted rope and holds them where they cling.
tips: Tangles two bugs at once; almost no damage.
Hold a heavy bug in a Buffalo Rifle's sights.
Bosses shake it off after a second.

corn.lore: Sweet canyon corn. Grows like a weed and keeps a rancher fed.
tips: Plant it between waves for quick scrap at the market.
Left click with corn out to eat it when your belly growls.

prickly_pear.lore: A stubborn cactus fruit. Takes its time, but it's food, water and medicine in one.
tips: Eating a pear heals a little and quenches thirst.
The pads give back more water than they drink.

firecracker_chili.lore: Hot enough to light a fuse. The Chili Mortar won't fire without it.
tips: Keep a stock before building a Chili Mortar: every shot burns one.
The market pays chitin for chilies, the only crop that does.

herbs.lore: Desert sage, dried and bundled. Better than any snake-oil tonic.
tips: Carry a few into every wave: a dose heals 50 HP.
Herbs fetch the most scrap per unit at the market.
